biotools.summary: LDAK-KVIK is a computationally efficient tool for mixed-model association analysis in genome-wide association studies, designed for analyzing quantitative and binary phenotypes. Published in Nature Genetics, it offers increased statistical power and can be used to generate polygenic scores.
